2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch addresses long cgroupfs stalls caused by inode allocation under kernfs_rwsem, which can lead to lock contention and OOM killer invocation. The solution is to allocate inodes outside the lock using kernfs_iget(). This approach ensures that inode allocation does not block other operations, such as readdir() or lookup(), even when the memcg is out of memory.
